title: feat(nm2oreadslz): neighbor-read of O at t+1 on two-axis same-lock z-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: Two-axis same-lock seed, z-probes, neighbor-read of O: fail at all four. This is the PR that names the seed-adjacency artifact outright - 'At t, O(A,t)={+e_2} already, because the step from A to the partner is +e_2 and that step is the partner's seed letter.' That phantom outgoing step, backed by no formation event, is what drives every same-lock z-probe failure in the band (#7357, #7365, #7368).
